Basaleśvara
son of Gurvāmbā an. Mallikārjuna of Kandukūri family; patron of Mallanārādhya (a. of Śivaliṅgasūryodayanāṭaka, MT. 2282).

Basavagadya
stotra. Adyar.
--stotra in praise of Basava, the founder of the Liṅgāyat sect. (Beg. jaya jaya basava). MD. 9544. 9545. 11420. Taylor II. p. 283.

Basavatantra

Basavanamaskārastotra
(Beg. zrIkaNThodbhava). MD. 9549 9550.

Basavapañcaratna

Basavapurāṇa

Pt.. (1) Vīraśaivamataprakāśikā Vol. IV. Mysore, 1892-95. See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 80. (2) in 21 chs. in two parts with Marathi meaning. Vīraśaivaliṅgībrāhmaṇadharmagranthamālā 7. Jagaddhitecchu Press. Poona, 1905. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 279. [Page245-b]

Bāṣkala
